item.text: I found the root cause: the project route regex lived inside an HTML template literal, so its backslashes were removed before the browser received the script. That caused a client-side syntax error and left the app’s `<main>` empty. I replaced the route match with a simple path-segment and numeric-ID check, then confirmed the served script parses and the health, blank-name, trimmed creation, and project detail flows respond as required.
